faqs: Do I need to choose a service before getting in touch?
No. Tell us your objective, what is holding you back, and the resources you already have. The first conversation helps identify whether you need a team, a system to build, or a combination of both.
What does AI Systems & Transformation cover?

Business scoping, architecture, implementation, integration, tests and evaluations, followed by handover and support within the agreed scope. Deliverables, responsibilities, and success criteria are defined in the proposal.
Can the two services be combined?
Yes. A team can add capacity while a system is being built, or continue evolving it afterward. We define a shared setup to coordinate the work and responsibilities.
Can I start with one engineer?
Yes. The composition follows your need: a focused senior addition or several complementary skills. We also define how the engineers work with your team, along with coordination and responsibilities.
How do you select talent?

NODINA Select brings together the method and tool behind the NODINA Select. It structures evaluation around six dimensions: engineering, AI, context, architecture, product, and collaboration. The tool brings the evidence together to support reviewer discussions and decisions.
What does the first week cover?

The first week is for choosing and approving your team: scoping the need, proposing profiles, meeting engineers and approving the team composition. The process starts from a complete brief, with suitable engineers available and interview slots agreed.
What happens at the end of the three weeks?

After one week of selection and approval, two additional weeks prepare onboarding: repository access, development environment, tools, product context and initial priorities. At the end of three weeks in total, the team is ready to work and produce its first pull requests (PRs), meaning code changes submitted for review. The timeline depends on availability and access preparation, and is agreed together.
Why Europe and Latin America?
These regions let us assemble teams for European and American companies. Skills, communication, and the shared working hours required for each engagement guide the selection.
What happens if the team needs to change?

We examine difficulties promptly and arrange an adjustment or handover when needed. Documentation and shared context help maintain continuity. Replacement terms and notice periods are defined in the contract.
What are the costs and commitments?
The service is priced through a tailored proposal, with no equity stake or recruitment fees. Scope, duration, coordination, change terms, and any tool or infrastructure costs are set out explicitly.
How do you handle code, data, and intellectual property?
We favor working in your environment. Access, confidentiality, approved tools, responsibilities, and intellectual property terms are addressed before work begins.
What does ‘by invitation’ mean?

You are welcome to tell us about your project. We assess the fit between your needs, our available capacity, and the proposed working relationship, then invite selected projects to proceed. We limit new partnerships each quarter to stay closely involved.
Which tools do the engineers use?
The choice depends on your stack and policies. We assess their ability to use the development assistants, models, agent workflows, and quality tools relevant to the engagement.

bio: He has built and led tech projects across France and the United States with six-figure budgets. His experience combines product delivery, team building, and collaboration with French and American lead developers and CTOs.

With a PhD in Computer Science, he conducts research in agent-based modeling and reinforcement learning. This research practice informs how he evaluates technical decisions, results, and the limitations of AI systems.

He also teaches software engineering and AI in a university MIAGE master’s program. This commitment helps develop the next generation of talent and provides an opportunity to recognize their potential as they learn.
His background also includes engineering training in nuclear energy at Arts et Métiers ParisTech and the CEA. His entrepreneurial work has also received an award from the European Space Agency.
award_text: His entrepreneurial work has also received an award from the European Space Agency.
